name: 乳児型ネマリンミオパチー

summary.text: Nemaline myopathy (NM) encompasses a large spectrum of myopathies characterized by hypotonia, weakness and depressed or absent deep tendon reflexes, with pathologic evidence of nemaline bodies (rods) on muscle biopsy.

symptoms.text: depressed or absent deep tendon reflexes
symptoms.evidence: depressed or absent deep tendon reflexes
